dict.string: InteRun reads your heart rate during a run so it can show it live and save it with the session. It also uses HealthKit to start a run on your Apple Watch from your phone. Your health data stays on your devices and is never sent anywhere.
InteRun uses HealthKit only to start a run on your Apple Watch from your phone. Your health data stays on your devices.

InteRun uses your phone's step counter to keep measuring your distance when GPS drops out — under trees, between tall buildings or in a tunnel — and to show your cadence. It stays on your phone and is never sent anywhere.
InteRun keeps tracking your run when your phone is locked or in a pocket, so your pace and route stay accurate for the whole session.
InteRun uses your location to measure pace, distance and your route while a session is running, including when your phone is locked or in your pocket.
InteRun uses your camera only when you choose Take Photo while making a share card, so the picture you post is one you just took. Photos are used on the card and never sent anywhere by InteRun.
InteRun saves a share card to your photo library when you tap Save to device. It only ever adds the card you made.
InteRun lets you pick one of your own photographs as the background of a share card. The photo is used on the card on this device and is never uploaded by InteRun.
